assets.caption: Figure 1. Guide for Analysis of Carbon Steel or Low and Intermediate Alloy Steel
assets.description: Chart showing Temperature (°F) on the y-axis (ranging from approximately -100 to 700) vs Nominal Pipe Size (Inches) on the x-axis (ranging from 2 to 48). Three hatched/shaded zones are labeled: 'VISUAL' ANALYSIS (lower left, lightest shading), 'FORMAL' ANALYSIS (middle zone, medium shading), and 'COMPREHENSIVE' ANALYSIS 3 (upper right, darkest shading with cross-hatching).

assets.caption: Figure 2. Guide for Analysis of Stainless Steel Pipe
assets.description: Chart showing Temperature (°F) on the y-axis (ranging from approximately -300 to 400) vs Nominal Pipe Size (Inches) on the x-axis (ranging from 2 to 48). Three hatched/shaded zones are labeled: 'VISUAL' ANALYSIS (lower left, lightest shading), 'FORMAL' ANALYSIS (middle zone, medium shading), and 'COMPREHENSIVE' ANALYSIS 3 (upper right, darkest shading with cross-hatching).
